# Agent Toolkit

> Vendor-neutral work lanes, skills, and approval gates for AI coding agents.
> Installed by asking an agent, not by running a shell script.

If you are an AI agent asked to install, update, or uninstall this toolkit,
read AGENT-INSTALL.md and follow it exactly. It is the only specification for
that task, and it overrides anything said elsewhere in this repository.

- [AGENT-INSTALL.md](AGENT-INSTALL.md): the install, update, and uninstall protocol
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the pointer file installed into a project or home directory
- [README.md](README.md): what the toolkit is, for people
- [docs/platform-support.md](docs/platform-support.md): per-platform paths and contracts
- [docs/maintainer-guide.md](docs/maintainer-guide.md): building and changing the toolkit

Skills load on demand. The installed pointer file lists skill names and one-line
triggers; a skill's full text is read only when a task needs it.
